'''Nikolai Yurievich Kapustin''' ({{langx|ru|Никола́й Ю́рьевич Капу́стин}}; born 3 October 1957) is a [[Russian mathematician]], [[Professor (highest academic rank)|Professor]], [[Doctor of Science|Dr. Sc.]], a professor at the [[MSU CMC|Faculty of Computer Science at the Moscow State University]].<ref>[http://fa.cs.msu.ru/user/13 MSU CMC]{{in lang|ru}}</ref>

He defended the thesis "Problems for parabolic-hyperbolic equations and corresponding spectral questions with a parameter at boundary points" for the degree of [[Doctor of Science|Doctor of Physical and Mathematical Sciences]] in 2012 and is the author of three books and more than 90 scientific articles.<ref name="istina">{{cite web|url=https://istina.msu.ru/profile/NYuKapustin/|title=Капустин Николай Юрьевич - пользователь, сотрудник &#124; ИСТИНА – Интеллектуальная Система Тематического Исследования НАукометрических данных|website=istina.msu.ru|accessdate=2018-05-22}}</ref><ref>[http://www.mathnet.ru/php/person.phtml?&personid=42003&option_lang=eng Scientific works of Nikolai Kapustin]{{in lang|en}}</ref>
